title: Hydra Dissociation and Reaggregation Protocol
author: Yashodara Abeykoon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6tyhepw
materials: Periodically during development, replace the medium with HM+P/S

steps.title: Wash Hydra in fresh medium
steps.instruction: Wash 30 Hydra several times in fresh Hydra Medium (HM) to remove debris.

steps.title: Transfer Hydra and add cold DM
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed Hydra to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, remove the residual medium, and add 1 mL of 4 °C Dissociation Medium (DM).

steps.title: Cold incubation of Hydra
steps.instruction: Incubate the Hydra at 4 °C for 30–60 min (longer incubations of several hours are tolerated without obvious detriment).

steps.title: Resuspend Hydra in cold DM
steps.instruction: Resuspend the Hydra in 1 mL fresh 4 °C DM.

steps.title: Initial shear and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Shear the suspension with a glass Pasteur pipette ~10–15 times until the supernatant becomes slightly turbid, allow the Hydra to settle, then discard the supernatant (ST1).

steps.title: Second shear to dissociate tissue
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL fresh 4 °C DM and shear by pipetting up and down with a glass Pasteur pipette for ~1–1.5 min until the solution becomes turbid and approximately half of the tissue is dissociated (ST2).

steps.title: Settle large pieces and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Allow the remaining large pieces to settle; the supernatant now contains the dissociated cells that will be used for reaggregation.

steps.title: Aliquot cell suspension at desired density
steps.instruction: Aliquot the supernatant (dissociated cell suspension) into new Eppendorf tubes at an approximate desired cell density (ST3).

steps.title: Centrifuge cell aliquots
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the aliquoted tubes in a microcentrifuge at 800 g for 6 min (ST4).

steps.title: Invert tubes to detach pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tubes for ~5–10 min to allow the pellet to passively separate from the tube wall (ST5).

steps.title: Transfer pellet to 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Transfer each pellet to a 24‑well plate containing either a 50/50 mixture of DM and HM + Penicillin/Streptomycin (P/S) or 100 % DM (ST6).

steps.title: Exchange medium according to initial composition
steps.instruction: Perform medium exchanges based on the initial medium used after aggregation.

substeps.instruction: If the initial medium is 50/50 DM/HM + P/S, make the first exchange at 12 h post‑aggregation (hpa) or 24 h pa depending on experiment length, then exchange approximately every 24 h for the remainder of the experiment.
If the initial medium is 100 % DM, exchange into 50/50 DM/HM + P/S at ~4 h pa, then into 100 % HM + P/S at ~16 h pa, and continue exchanging medium roughly every 24 h thereafter (ST7).
